As Apple (AAPL) Market Valuation Rose, Avalon Global Asset Management Has Upped by $1.37 Million Its Holding; Anheuser Busch Inbev Sa/Nv (BUD) Shareholder Btg Pactual Global Asset Management LTD Cut Stake
June 17, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Avalon Global Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 20.5% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Avalon Global Asset Management Llc bought 8,200 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 48,200 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.09M, up from 40,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Avalon Global Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $928.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $188.84. About 33.10 million shares traded or 10.09% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Btg Pactual Global Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Anheuser Busch Inbev Sa/Nv (BUD) by 24.11% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Btg Pactual Global Asset Management Ltd sold 65,272 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 205,460 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $22.59M, down from 270,732 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Btg Pactual Global Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Anheuser Busch Inbev Sa/Nv for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $191.14 billion market cap company.
